text: The bug is on line 40: it truncates the value at `#` and drops everything after the second `=`. Fix by partitioning on the first `=` only and keeping the full value:

arguments.old:
parts = line.split("=")
        if len(parts) < 2:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: expected key = value")
        key = parts[0].strip()
        if not key:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: empty key")
        result[section][key] = parts[1].split("#")[0].strip()
arguments.new:
key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
        if not sep:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: expected key = value")
        key = key.strip()
        if not key:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: empty key")
        result[section][key] = value.strip()
